notes.title: Version 2.2
notes.content:
Version 2.2
  Again, just small fixes. No major changes.

Bug fixes
 - Fixed some translations and character names not being displayed

Illustrations
 - I corrected the distorted proportions in 15 illustrations.
   08, 09(1, 2), 25, 27, 29, 31, 34, 35, 37(1, 2, 4, 5, 7), 40

Music
 - Two background music tracks have been revised.
   Chapter 3 music: the last 15 seconds.
   Chapter 5 music: one note.

The year 2025 has begun. I hope it will be a good year for everyone.

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.1 -> Version 2.0[/b]

[b]Overview[/b]
- Words: 4,000 -> 10,000 (Japanese equivalent)
- Illustrations: 21 -> 44 (including rough drawings and landscape paintings)
- Music: 2 -> 7

[b]Changed[/b]
- Moved Chapter 3 to Chapter 5
- Added Chapters 2 and 3
- Added Ending (1 click to skip)
- Unlock all locked elements from the beginning (Spoiler alert)
- Rewrite the afterword

[b]Modified[/b]
- Existing illustrations, text, and songs were slightly modified.
